intro: Behind Goldshire's blacksmith, Brother Wilhelm trains young paladins in the Holy Light. He guides them as they leave Northshire Abbey and take their first steps into Elwynn Forest.

p: Brother Wilhelm trains new paladins behind Goldshire's smithy. Northshire Valley shelters those who begin their path in the Light, but many seek his guidance when they enter the wider forest. He teaches them their sacred duties as they leave the abbey and take up the work of protecting the realm.

Brother Wilhelm guides aspiring paladins toward the Tome of Divinity. Its rite teaches initiates the weight of sacrifice and the power of divine redemption. Through it, they test their devotion and learn to wield the Light to resurrect fallen comrades and uphold justice across the Kingdom of Stormwind.
